description: Subdermal weave of the grade The First wears, laid in a lattice from throat to hip so the whole torso answers at once. Halcyon doesn't list it. There's no shelf it sits on and no price on any board — there's an account, and either it's the kind of account this goes on or it's not.

failure_messages.burnout: The whole torso locks rigid, throat to hip, and holds you upright in a way that has nothing to do with standing.
failure_messages.dead: The lattice goes slack under the skin all at once, and you feel every separate strand of it stop.
failure_messages.fault: A band of the lattice drops out across the ribs and that stripe of you stops reporting in.
failure_messages.strain: The lattice tightens across the ribs and forgets to let go, and for a moment breathing is something you're doing on purpose.

name: Seraph Lattice
